svg.title: From next-token prediction to agentic AI
svg.desc: Three steps (pre-training, post-training, tools + agent loop) turn an untrained model into a pre-trained model, an assistant and a tool-using agent. Middle row: the model; bottom row: the chat.

g.text: Learn by predicting the next word
Run the model in a loop with tools
+ Tools, called by a special word
orbit lamp the seven glass of
Completes text, not yet an assistant
Can retrieve and act; needs oversight
